name: Shubham Chaudhary
headline: Full Stack Engineer (frontend-heavy)
summary: Full stack developer (frontend-heavy) with 4+ years of software experience building production web and desktop applications. Specializes in React.js, Next.js, JavaScript and TypeScript on the frontend, backed by Node.js, Express.js APIs and PostgreSQL data layers. Comfortable owning a feature end to end, from UI architecture and state management through REST API design and deployment, with working knowledge of Docker, Nginx, CI/CD pipelines and AWS fundamentals.
careerNote: Software career started in Sept 2022. Before that, worked 2 years (June 2020 - June 2022) as a Mechanical Engineer.

contact.resume: Download from the Contact section of this site, the Start menu, or the 'resume' command in the MS-DOS Prompt.

highlights: Frontend Developer on Agent Fabric UI, a React 19+ TypeScript enterprise web app built with Vite, Mantine and Redux Toolkit Query, enabling teams to configure, test, qualify and govern AI agents across their full lifecycle.

Developed the Trust Studio verification UI for testing AI agents across Identity, Consistency, Boundary and Evidence 'gates', surfacing per-scenario pass/fail results and gate-level qualification status.
Used Cursor for AI-assisted coding, debugging and iterative development.
Engineered RunTheDay, a US-based race registration and results platform (Next.js, React.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Material UI, Redux) with real-time multi-role interactions.
Implemented WebSocket for live race results and Firebase OTP-based authentication and onboarding.
Built and updated backend REST APIs with Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB during critical production support for RunTheDay.

Developed a cross-platform Windows/Linux desktop app for Edique (Electron.js, Node.js, React.js, TypeScript) with auto-update and auto-start, logging power on/off and sleep/wake events and sending minute-wise heartbeat data over WebSocket.
Built SportZentric, a sports batch creation and registration platform plus its Admin Panel (React.js, RTK Query, Styled Components, Material UI, React Hook Form) with Firebase OTP onboarding.
Developed REST API integrations between Drupal and external services and maintained Drupal-based web applications.
Led a team of 10-12 technicians in the maintenance department of a bathmat manufacturing plant.
Owned preventive and breakdown maintenance, scheduled repairs, found root causes of equipment failures, coordinated with production and upheld safety and quality standards.
